name: Tabernanthine
summary: Tabernanthine is an alkaloid found in Tabernanthe iboga. It has been used in laboratory experiments to study how addiction affects the brain. Tabernanthine persistently reduced the self-administration of cocaine and morphine in rats.

pharmacology.text: It is kappa opioid agonist (Ki = 0.15 μM) and NMDA receptor (Ki = 10.5 μM) antagonist. Compared to ibogaine, it binds weakly to σ1 and σ2 receptors.

uses.text: It has been used in laboratory experiments to study how addiction affects the brain.

summaryZh: 馬山茶鹼（英語：Tabernanthine）是一種在鵝花樹中發現的生物鹼。它已被用於實驗室實驗，以研究成癮如何影響大腦。馬山茶鹼可持續減少大鼠古柯鹼和嗎啡的自我給藥。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Its close relative ibogaine can cause vomiting, poor coordination and dangerous heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它的近親伊博格鹼可能造成嘔吐、協調變差與危險的心律問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它的近亲伊博格碱可能造成呕吐、协调制差与危险的心律问题。

fact.en: Tabernanthine is a near twin of ibogaine: the two molecules are identical except for where a single methoxy group sits on the indole ring.
fact.zh: 馬山茶鹼幾乎是伊博格鹼的雙胞胎：兩個分子完全相同，只差在吲哚環上一個甲氧基的位置不同。
fact.zhHans: 马山茶碱几乎是伊博格碱的双胞胎：两个分子完全相同，只差在吲哚环上一个甲氧基的位置不同。
